name: promptit
description: Slash-command prompt launcher for ChatGPT and Gemini

scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:test && xvfb-run -a env -u NO_COLOR TMPDIR=/tmp PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test playwright test
scripts.test:e2e:live: pnpm build:test && xvfb-run -a env -u NO_COLOR TMPDIR=/tmp PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts && pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest
scripts.test:e2e:live:prod: pnpm build && pnpm check:manifest && xvfb-run -a env -u NO_COLOR TMPDIR=/tmp PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts tests/live/live-prod-insert.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:headed: pnpm build:test && xvfb-run -a env -u NO_COLOR TMPDIR=/tmp PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test playwright test --headed
scripts.test:e2e:ui: pnpm build:test && xvfb-run -a env -u NO_COLOR TMPDIR=/tmp PLAYWRIGHT_EXTENSION_HEADED=1 PROMPTIT_EXTENSION_PATH=dist-test playwright test --ui
